title: Kissed Greek Cabbage Avgolemono Soup
description: A fermented, snappy, energizing Greek soup that blends crisp cabbage with a creamy lemon custard, all vegan-friendly and bursting with bright flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic, sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the shredded cabbage and sauerkraut, cooking until the cabbage softens, 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce the heat and let the soup simmer for 10 minutes to meld flavors.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chickpea flour and lemon juice until smooth, forming a slurry.
Gradually pour the slurry into the simmering soup while stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Keep the soup at a low simmer for an additional 5 minutes, allowing it to thicken.
Remove the pot from heat, then stir in the lemon zest, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with a swirl of fresh lemon juice for extra brightness.
